manifest.title: Turn View
manifest.description: The front camera in the instrument cluster with a turn card and, near each turn, a blue turn sign (three chevrons pointing the way), from BMW navigation, CarPlay or Android Auto; the camera alone without a route. Or on the head unit instead (0.9.0, the Turn View app's Camera page: Picture on Head unit), at any speed: the camera's whole picture with the same card and sign, a kerb-parking aid. iDrive 8: pick "Turn View AR" in the cluster widget menu (from the car's next start after installing). iDrive 7: off at every start of the car; switch it on in the Turn View app and set Instrument cluster > Central display area to Map view; the camera takes the map area there. Not together with Waze on cluster on the cluster: set Waze on cluster to HUD only (the cluster and the HUD show 2 videos at most). Set up and calibrated in the Turn View app. Drawn by Cluster renderer (robertnisipeanu/idrive-apps) 0.5.10 or newer. No coding needed.

Not together with Waze on cluster on the cluster: set Waze on cluster to HUD only (the cluster and the HUD show 2 videos at most).
